text.en:
The bond of ten thousand dollars furnished by Melchor Babasa and Apolonio Belmonte in favor
of the defendant Pedro Alvarez, alias Araro, which has been declared forfeited by the Court of First Instance
of Batangas, is hereby remitted.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this law, the same shall take effect on its
Enacted, February 27, 1914.
